svg.title: Figure 5 | Retrieve batches and confirm completion
svg.desc: Arrows indicate paging continuation, without increasing permissions or scope. A page size of 100 is illustrative. Check result codes and the final empty cookie; calculate the total from actual returned entries.

g.text: Figure 5 | Retrieve batches and confirm completion
Retrieve 100 entries and retain the server continuation cookie.
Send the previous cookie and retrieve another batch; 100 in this example.
Check each result status until the final empty cookie.
